implementationSummary: Added analytics_kpi_masking package with mask_public_analytics_envelope — a pure stdlib HMAC transform that aliases shop display name and product/order/SKU identities to stable Demo aliases, strips merchant_id and buyer PII, replaces shop_id with demo alias, and preserves KPI series numeric magnitudes unchanged for public Demo envelopes (ADR-038 identity mask, real magnitudes).
assumptions: Precompute envelopes may include an optional identity block with shop_display_name, merchant_id, products, and orders — wired by later slices or read path (#531)
Fixed HMAC pepper (_DEMO_MASK_KEY) is acceptable for public Demo alias stability; not a secret rotation surface
Internal Juli shop UUID masked to demo-shop-* alias in public payload; server-side cache keys remain unmasked until #531 wires the transform
risks: Identity block not yet populated by precompute — mask function is ready but end-to-end Demo read depends on #531 + upstream identity enrichment
Product title alias keyed by product id — orders referencing title-only use title string as stability key which may differ from id-keyed product aliases
